author: 3owj
content: Added --all flag to csnotes process. run_all() snapshots unprocessed session IDs from manifest in date order, then calls run() for each in sequence. --for-course acts as a course filter in --all mode. Stops on first failure, workspace preserved for csnotes recover. Incompatible with --session, --next, --course, --topic, --resource via clap conflicts_with_all.
